title: Rule coverage
intro_one: Calculated from the {{count}} saved request when this page loads. These figures count records; they do not estimate time saved.
intro_other: Calculated from the {{count}} saved requests when this page loads. These figures count records; they do not estimate time saved.
metricsAppear: Metrics appear once requests are saved.
withinRulesText: {{n}} of {{count}} requests matched an owner rule, rather than a default yellow route or a safety rule.
greenText: {{n}} of {{count}} requests could follow approved steps without the owner.
waitingText: Status is “waiting for owner” right now.
amberReasonsHint: The rule or default route behind each yellow decision.
missingHint: Facts that were missing or uncertain in the current decision of each request.
overriddenHint: Yellow or red decisions the owner then approved as an exception, by rule.

reason.default_unsupported: Request type not covered by any policy
reason.default_missing_policy: No active policy for this request type
reason.default_no_matching_rule: No rule covers these facts (a gap)

suggestionsHint: Found by looking for at least two owner approvals of the same yellow or red rule with no complaint or welfare concern. Suggestions use pattern analysis, not AI. They stay inactive until the owner turns one into a draft, tests it and activates it. Past exceptions are not treated as general permission. Each suggestion's summary is the pattern finder's own English wording.
newPatterns_one: {{count}} new pattern found; the owner can add it.
newPatterns_other: {{count}} new patterns found; the owner can add them.
